name: @veren/commander-tests
description: Use when you need the veren CLI's `tests` command group or isolated DSH training grounds as a standard Cordis plugin module (name/inject/Config/apply): it creates per-plugin DSH_HOME directories under the repository's deepseek/.dsh, copies keys and model configuration from the global ~/.dsh, initializes the target profile, and lists, inspects, starts or removes grounds only with explicit authorization; skip it when you manage DSH homes with your own scripts.
